annotations.title: Roles that fit a set of skills

description: Job titles in Finland whose ads ask for a given set of skills: how much of each title's usual skill set the skills cover, the skills still missing, how many of those jobs are open now and the median stated pay. Fits "what jobs could I do with Excel, customer service and SQL". English skill names match best. A heuristic from skills named in ads, not an assessment of the person. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

skills.description: The skills the user has, e.g. ["Excel", "customer service", "SQL"].
